title: Zesty Light Middle Eastern Chicken Tagine
description: A spicy and light Middle Eastern dish featuring chicken, muscovado sugar, and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute
Stir in the muscovado sugar and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and cook, steaming the chicken and sauce, until the chicken is cooked through, about 20-25 minutes
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice, garnished with additional parsley if desired
